About Linggango
Linggango
An all-in-one Terraria-inspired modpack designed for every type of player. Perfect for those who enjoy structured progression, challenging combat, and endless creativity!
450+ Carefully Selected Mods – Magic, tech, exploration, and quality of life
2300+ Integrated Quests – Structured progression through FTB Quests
85+ Unique Bosses – Challenging encounters with epic rewards
Deep Integration – Mods work together, not separately
Multiple Progression Paths – Magic (Ars Nouveau), Tech (Create), Adventure
